skills.name: Mole in Hiding
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects self. Struggle: Creates a shield with HP equal to 23.71% of final max HP. This effect is continuous. ■ Activates when using Burst Skill while not in the Struggle state. Affects self. Struggle: Creates a shield with HP equal to 23.71% of final max HP. This effect is continuous. ■ Activates when Struggle ends. Affects self. Max HP ▲ 2.99% continuously. Stacks up to 5 times.

skills.name: All-Out Support
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates after landing 60 normal attacks while in the Struggle state. Affects the target. Taunts for 4 sec. ■ Activates when an ally or self destroys an enemy's part. Affects all allies. Sustained Damage ▲ 1.2%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 15 sec. ■ Activates when an ally or self destroys an enemy's part. Affects the 1 enemy unit(s) with the highest ATK. Deals 13.72% of final ATK as sustained damage every second for 15 sec.

skills.name: Survival Tactics of the Weak
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates when self is in Struggle status. Affects self. Restores shield HP equal to 8.89% of the skill user's final max HP. ■ Activates when this unit is not in the Struggle state. Affects self. Max HP ▲ 5.96% for 10 sec. ■ Affects all allies. Sustained Damage ▲ 6% for 10 sec.
